label: Respect of physical motion: A respect in which there is motion in the strict sense of the Physics…
term: respect of physical motion (place, quality, quantity)
definition: A respect in which there is motion in the strict sense of the Physics: a place, a quality or a quantity (Physics V.1-2: motion is in these three categories only). Lean: the primitive `IsPhysicalRespect r` of TruthCore.Greek.Aristotle.Physics.Typed. The VIII.4 readings are restricted to such respects; STMT-EVERY-REDUCTION-TO-ACT-IS-PHYSICAL-MOTION is the separate, unattributed premise that every reduction from potency to act is in such a respect.
